verdict.rationale: Kick offers MCP and CLI access that can read and update live bookkeeping data, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test workspace, or dry-run mode. Approval gating on AI changes, period locks, and separate per-entity books are adjacent controls, not isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
